race.comment: TACITLY (6) talented gelding who returned from a lengthy break with an eye-catching second from a wide gate over 1400m at this track. Gets a better set-up for this out to the mile and expected to go quickly through the grades this time in. MAGIC MERLIN (14) maps well again third-up and desperate to get out to the 1600m. Gripped on well with the 59kg for a fighting on-pace second over 1400m at Gunnedah. First start on his home track and shapes as one of the leading contenders. AURORA EFFECT (12) dropped in grade on the quick back-up with a well-deserved Maiden win over 1700m at Grafton. Shaping up nicely and can race a touch closer here. No surprise to see her win again. VALEDOR (8) won well on debut, then raced without luck when he chipped away late to finish fifth over 1400m at Gunnedah. Well drawn and will have little problem running a strong mile.
